status: post-primary exploratory robustness checks, declared before supplementary outcomes

fixed_size_ablation.treatment: all logical message sizes set to the pooled N20 primary median; timestamps, endpoints, kinds and ground truth unchanged
fixed_size_ablation.interpretation: isolates size variability; does not remove inference jitter or establish LLM-specific causation

energy_matching.selection: piecewise linear interpolation in calibration mean energy, clipped to tested budget range; ignore leakage outcomes
energy_matching.report: actual confirmation energy mismatch, paired CIs; no claim of exact matching if mismatch exceeds 10 percent

alternative_attacker.history: current and two previous windows, zero history before mission start, causal lags only
alternative_attacker.folds: same mission-disjoint four folds; no hyperparameter search
alternative_attacker.interpretation: alternative attacker with longer history; no guarantee it dominates RF

shared_resources: existing idle gate; own container only, 2 CPUs, 12 GiB; no service restarts, model downloads or unrelated cleanup
submission: no autonomous submission; author identity, declarations, repository release and author review remain required
